definitions.explanation: A half-cylindrical tile used to cap the joints between rows of flat tiles on a traditional tiled roof, keeping rainwater from seeping between the rows.

examples.english: To place a round tile on top.

examples.japanese: {丸瓦|まるがわら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{平瓦|ひらがわら}→平瓦：30858_hiragawara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Flat tiles line up beneath the round tiles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{丸瓦|まるがわら}がいくつか⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Several round tiles fell off in the earthquake.
